honesty: FIEZEL does not predict IELTS or TOEFL scores. This rubric is a practice and feedback tool; official band scores only come from official exams.

rubric.note: Five criteria, each scored 0-4. The first four follow the IELTS Writing rubric family; the fifth separates register and mechanics so you can practice independently.

task_response.label: Task achievement / response
task_response.asks: Are all parts of the prompt fully addressed, and is your position clear?
levels: Does not address the task, or writes about an unrelated topic.
Touches on the topic but misses most parts of the prompt; no clear position.
Addresses most parts of the prompt; takes a position but shifts or under-develops it.
Addresses all parts with a clear position; some ideas need stronger supporting detail.
Fully addresses all parts with a clear, consistent position; main ideas are well developed with relevant reasons or examples.

coherence_cohesion.label: Coherence and cohesion
coherence_cohesion.asks: Can a reader follow the flow of ideas smoothly without re-reading?
levels: No clear progression or structure to follow.
Ideas jump randomly with almost no paragraphing or linking devices.
Uses paragraphs, but some ideas are misplaced or linking words are repetitive.
Logically organized paragraphs with apt connectors; occasional minor gaps between sentences.
Each paragraph develops one central idea in logical order with natural, seamless cohesion.

lexical_resource.label: Lexical resource
lexical_resource.asks: Are word choices accurate, natural, and varied enough for the topic?
levels: Insufficient vocabulary to convey intended meaning.
Relies only on basic words; heavy repetition and frequent word-choice errors.
Adequate for everyday topics; less common words often miss the intended meaning.
Varied and generally accurate, including topic-specific vocabulary; rare slips do not impede meaning.
Flexible, precise vocabulary with natural collocations and very few word-choice slips.

grammatical_range_accuracy.label: Grammatical range and accuracy
grammatical_range_accuracy.asks: Are sentence structures varied and grammatically accurate?
levels: Word groups do not yet form complete grammatical sentences.
Almost exclusively short, repetitive simple sentences; errors hinder comprehension.
Mix of simple and compound sentences; frequent errors, though the main message remains clear.
Good variety of structures including complex clauses; most sentences are error-free.
Wide grammatical range used accurately and naturally; only rare minor slips.

register_mechanics.label: Register and mechanics
register_mechanics.asks: Is the tone appropriate for the reader, and are spelling and punctuation clean?
levels: Register and mechanics cannot yet be evaluated.
Tone does not suit the task; frequent spelling and punctuation errors.
Tone shifts unevenly between formal and casual; noticeable spelling or punctuation errors.
Tone matches the task; only a few spelling or punctuation mistakes.
Consistent, well-judged tone throughout with clean spelling, punctuation, and paragraphing.

ielts_task2.label: IELTS Writing Task 2
ielts_task2.note: Essay. In the real exam, responses under 250 words receive a Task Response penalty.

ielts_task1_letter.label: IELTS General Training Writing Task 1
ielts_task1_letter.note: Letter. All three bullet points in the prompt must be answered; missing any bullet lowers Task Achievement.

ielts_task1_report.label: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1
ielts_task1_report.note: Data report. Summarize key features and make comparisons — do not give personal opinions or speculate on causes.

toefl_discussion.label: TOEFL iBT Writing for an Academic Discussion
toefl_discussion.note: Academic discussion response. State your own position AND engage with classmates' contributions.

toefl_integrated_adapted.label: TOEFL iBT Integrated Writing (text adaptation)
toefl_integrated_adapted.note: Summarize how the counter-arguments challenge each source point. ADAPTATION: real TOEFL uses an audio lecture; here points are written so you practice synthesis directly.
